$comment: Permission modes shared by the CLI (src/permissions/) and the desktop app (apps/server/src/permissions/): engine permission rules per mode, in evaluation order (the engine takes the LAST matching rule). Keep the two copies byte-identical (PARITY.sha256).

careful.title: Careful
careful.summary: Asks before every file change and every command. Reading and searching run freely.

normal.title: Normal
normal.summary: Asks only before risky actions: recursive deletes, sudo, git push or hard resets, changes outside the project, reading secrets, piping downloads into a shell, publishing packages. Computer use asks once per app per chat, then only before paying, buying or ordering and before typing a password.

auto.title: Auto
auto.summary: Never asks. The agent runs everything it decides to run.
